summary: Create a Node HTTP server with Node request/response stream and EventEmitter semantics.

target.notes: Returns a Server; request listeners receive IncomingMessage Readable and ServerResponse Writable objects; parser/subclass options are observable.

semantics.notes: Returns a Server; request listeners receive IncomingMessage Readable and ServerResponse Writable objects; parser/subclass options are observable.

caveats: Preserve Node stream/EventEmitter, host ordering, header state, and network/TLS behavior rather than substituting unrelated .NET HTTP defaults.

tests.name: normal semantics
tests.expected_behavior: returns a Server and registers the request listener

tests.name: edge semantics
tests.expected_behavior: custom request class semantics must be preserved
